g.title: tools
g.text: the code as written, nothing runs
what was looked at, not committed
views over any of the above
what ran, when, for how long
did this method run, and how much?
ran / did not, attributed to tests
which objects exist, who made them, who keeps them
which objects? ONE walk, five object sets
all reachable, charged to the first-reached parent
what is in young space now (move detection)
the continuous signal, keyed by time only
old / young / free, scavenges, tenures, survivors, fps
process RSS, non-image bytes, GPU upload, VRAM

g.title: bus
g.text: every tool speaks one vocabulary, the
so any result can become a
set in one view lights up
in every other view that contains the key

g.title: gaps
g.text: no call graph, no fan-in / fan-out,
no package dependency map, no ivar access graph
LOC and bytes are the only size proxies:
no branches, nesting depth or send count
lanes, but no run / ready / wait states
FFI / GL / file / socket time is
no age distribution over the live set
the Alloc Tracer knows the stack only
while it is armed, for classes chosen up front
